title: MainHub access troubleshooting
summary: A demonstration first-response checklist for common access problems before a technical issue is escalated.
contentNotice: Demonstration content for Atlas interface development; not final MOSCATELLI policy.

blocks.text: Confirm the correct account, connectivity, browser state and whether the issue is isolated before escalating with a concise description of what was tested.

items: Correct MOSCATELLI account is being used
Browser has been refreshed or restarted
Issue reproduced in a clean browser context where appropriate
Exact error message or behaviour has been captured

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: Troubleshooting must never involve sharing passwords, bypassing access controls or exposing production secrets. Access should be restored through the approved authentication path.
If the problem appears permission-related, record which area the user expected to access rather than attempting to reveal restricted content through another account.

steps.title: Describe the failure
steps.text: State the route or action, expected result and actual result.

steps.title: Attach useful evidence
steps.text: Include the exact error text and a screenshot only when it does not expose sensitive data.

steps.title: List checks already performed
steps.text: Prevent the next person from repeating basic troubleshooting unnecessarily.
